d: Ravensthorpe Restaurant is building its pre-opening Kitchen Team for a distinctive new hospitality concept in Adliya, Manama.
The venue will feature approximately 100 seats, offering both an accessible casual dining experience and a refined premium steakhouse experience within one cohesive culinary identity.

At the heart of Ravensthorpe is a bold concept inspired by Nordic and medieval European traditions, old-world European character, rustic elegance, contemporary technique, and the strength of a modern European grill and steakhouse approach.

This is a unique opportunity to join a new restaurant from the beginning and become part of a culinary team that will help shape the identity, quality, consistency, and long-term success of the opening.
The kitchen team will play a key role in delivering a menu that balances creativity, strong technique, operational discipline, guest appeal, and consistency across every service.
q: Previous experience as a Chef De Cuisine or a similar hospitality leadership position is preferred.
Strong knowledge of European/international cuisine and modern culinary techniques.
Strong menu planning and recipe development skills.
Ability to manage and motivate a multicultural kitchen team.
r: Assist with kitchen setup and equipment requirements

Ensure proper storage and rotation of food products using FIFO principles.
